en-US.title: CeCeMate product manual
en-US.description: Search the packaged Chinese product manual locally and return exact evidence with chapter and manual version citations. No network or model calls.

usage.title: Ask about platform features
usage.description: Ask about industry chains, regional companies, customer leads, company information or policy search. Inspect the cited manual excerpts and their limitations.

requirements: The operator must enable knowledge_search with provider cecemate-manual and restart Gateway. The corpus is shared by all users of this provider; dataset and document selection are unsupported.

zh-CN.title: CeCeMate 产品手册
zh-CN.description: 本地检索打包的中文产品手册，返回含章节、手册版本的原文证据。无需网络或模型调用。

usage.title: 查询平台功能
usage.description: 可询问产业链、区域企业、潜客商机、企业信息或政策检索；请结合来源原文和限制说明阅读。

requirements: 管理员须将 knowledge_search 配置为 cecemate-manual 并重启 Gateway。此手册向该 Provider 的全部用户共享，不支持按知识库或文档筛选。
